purpose: Hostile D0 retest of two new regime-gated hypotheses generated by the frozen Sprint 7 regime diagnostic. This sprint is post-diagnostic contaminated hypothesis generation, not validation.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

regime_classifier.volatility_threshold: strictly prior rolling median of RV20

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day
execution.rebalance: daily including transitions into and out of cash

trend_gated_momentum_acceleration.hypothesis: Cross-sectional momentum acceleration has positive next-day expectancy specifically when the pre-frozen BTC regime classifier is in either trend state.
trend_gated_momentum_acceleration.score: sum completed returns over most recent N days minus sum over immediately preceding N days
trend_gated_momentum_acceleration.portfolio_when_active: long highest two scores +25% each and short lowest two -25% each
trend_gated_momentum_acceleration.principal_reversed_control: same regime gate and exact reversed ranking
trend_gated_momentum_acceleration.complement_regime_control: same ranking and timing, active only when regime is outside HIGH_VOL_TREND and LOW_VOL_TREND

low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.hypothesis: Upside-minus-downside BTC beta asymmetry has positive next-day cross-sectional expectancy specifically in the pre-frozen LOW_VOL_RANGE state.
low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.score: OLS slope versus BTC on positive-BTC days minus OLS slope versus BTC on negative-BTC days over most recent N completed returns; intercept included separately
low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.portfolio_universe: nine alts; BTC factor target weight is always zero
low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.portfolio_when_active: long highest two alt scores +25% each and short lowest two -25% each
low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.principal_reversed_control: same LOW_VOL_RANGE gate and exact reversed alt ranking
low_vol_range_beta_asymmetry.complement_regime_control: same ranking and timing, active only outside LOW_VOL_RANGE

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants in an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_result_only_allows: new candidate ID frozen before independent reproduction, D2, non-overlapping D3 and prospective D4
